title: Organization settings
intro: Manage visual identity, languages, staff, and internal documents.
logoHelp: JPG, PNG, or WebP. Maximum 1 MB.
contrastHelp: Colors are accepted when their text meets WCAG AA contrast.
languageLocked: Because of the grant obligation, Catalan must remain enabled and the default for Ramassà.
actionError: The action could not be completed. Check the details and try again.
removeConfirm: Confirm that you want to remove access and revoke every session for this person.
documentsIntro: A private area for insurance, inventory, and organization resources. Only staff and administrators can access it.
documentHelp: PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP, DOC, or DOCX. Maximum 10 MB.
fundingNotice: The Generalitat funding acknowledgment is mandatory and cannot be removed in these settings.

team.title: Team
team.intro: Invite people, choose what each person may do, and remove access. The organization always keeps at least one person with Team management.
team.presetsIntro: A preset sets up a person quickly. Changing a preset changes nobody until you choose to apply it.
team.errorLastManager: At least one active person must keep Team management. Give it to someone else first.
team.errorNotHeld: You can only change permissions that you hold yourself.
team.errorBuiltIn: A built-in preset cannot be deleted. You can restore its default instead.
team.editAccessIntro: Start from a preset, then turn single permissions on or off.
team.editPresetIntro: Choose the permissions people get when this preset is applied.
team.applyTitle_one: Apply the changes to the {{count}} person who uses {{preset}}?
team.applyTitle_other: Apply the changes to the {{count}} people who use {{preset}}?
team.applyIntro: Their access changes only if you apply it here. The audit log records each change.

apply.nobody: No, keep their access as it is

team.lockedHint: You can only change permissions that you hold yourself. The others are shown but locked.
team.testAccountHelp: A test account signs in with the fixed code of the test environment. Mark only the team accounts that run tests.
team.testAccountFailed: The test account could not be changed. Try again.

participants_view.label: See participants
participants_view.description: The participant list and the Basic fields: name, photo, language, referring entity, sizes, sign-ups and attendance.

participants_view_personal.label: See personal details
participants_view_personal.description: Also date and place of birth, nationality, city, document type, dependants and the contact at the referring entity.

participants_view_sensitive.label: See sensitive details
participants_view_sensitive.description: Also the four encrypted fields: address, postal code, phone and document number.

participants_notes.label: Team notes
participants_notes.description: Read and write the team's internal notes on a participant.

participants_deactivate.label: Deactivate accounts
participants_deactivate.description: Deactivate and reactivate a player's account.

rgpd_erase.label: RGPD erasure
rgpd_erase.description: Handle deletion requests and erase a player's data. Permanent deletion also needs Team management.

test_players_manage.label: Test players
test_players_manage.description: Create, view, edit and delete test players to try the registration. On its own, this permission shows no real player.

equipment_handover.label: Hand over material
equipment_handover.description: Record a handover to a player and see the handover history.

equipment_receive.label: Receive material
equipment_receive.description: Record material that arrives at the storeroom.

equipment_count.label: Count stock
equipment_count.description: Correct the stock counts after a count.

equipment_items.label: Manage the item list
equipment_items.description: Add and edit the types of material and their sizes.

attendance_mark.label: Take attendance
attendance_mark.description: Take attendance for a session, online or offline.

attendance_reports.label: Attendance reports
attendance_reports.description: See attendance per event and per participant.

announcements_edit.label: Edit announcements
announcements_edit.description: Create and change announcement drafts and translations.

announcements_publish.label: Publish announcements
announcements_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete announcements.

events_edit.label: Edit events
events_edit.description: Create and change events, trainings, recurring sessions and event categories.

events_publish.label: Publish events
events_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete events.

knowledge_edit.label: Edit knowledge base
knowledge_edit.description: Create and change articles, and review story submissions.

knowledge_publish.label: Publish knowledge base
knowledge_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete articles and stories.

services_edit.label: Edit services
services_edit.description: Create and change services in the directory and their categories.

services_publish.label: Publish services
services_publish.description: Publish, schedule, unpublish and delete services.

services_review.label: Review entity services
services_review.description: Approve or reject the services partner entities submit.

forum_moderate.label: Moderate the forum
forum_moderate.description: Handle reports, hide and restore posts, and ban players from posting.

gallery_moderate.label: Moderate the gallery
gallery_moderate.description: Approve, hide and remove gallery photos.

messages_inbox.label: Team inbox
messages_inbox.description: Read and answer the conversations between the team and players or entities.

mentoring_manage.label: Mentoring
mentoring_manage.description: See mentoring requests, including their private topic, and write the team's notes.

feedback_view.label: Read feedback
feedback_view.description: Read the private feedback players send.

surveys_manage.label: Manage surveys
surveys_manage.description: Create, publish and close surveys and polls.

notifications_send.label: Send notifications
notifications_send.description: Send push notifications to players and manage the templates.

referrals_manage.label: Referrals
referrals_manage.description: See and update referrals from entities, including the referred person's phone, notes and updates.

entities_manage.label: Partner entities
entities_manage.description: Add and edit partner entities, their collaborators and invitations.

impact_view.label: Impact dashboard
impact_view.description: See the impact dashboard and make impact reports for funders.

export_participants.label: Export participants
export_participants.description: Export the participant list without the four sensitive fields.

export_participants_sensitive.label: Export with sensitive details
export_participants_sensitive.description: Export the participant list with the four sensitive fields. Also needs See sensitive details.

audit_view.label: Audit log
audit_view.description: See who saw, changed or exported what, and when.

settings_organization.label: Organization details
settings_organization.description: Edit the name, contact details and languages.

onboarding_design.label: Onboarding design
onboarding_design.description: Edit what a player sees the first time she opens the app: questions, the document note, seasons and the season authorization.

settings_documents.label: Internal documents
settings_documents.description: Manage internal documents such as insurance forms and inventories.

team_manage.label: Team management
team_manage.description: Add and remove team members, edit presets and toggles, and reset a lost second factor.

seasonsIntro: Publishing the current season's authorization makes returning players register again.
seasonCreateFailed: The season could not be created.

types.search_choice: One choice from a long list

privacyNotes.normal: Everyone on the team who works with the players sees it.
privacyNotes.personal: Only people with the personal details permission see it. It also goes out when players are exported.
privacyNotes.sensitive: It is stored encrypted. Only people with the sensitive details permission see it.

privacyExamples.normal: For example: T-shirt size, whether she likes football.
privacyExamples.personal: For example: address, phone, date of birth.
privacyExamples.sensitive: For example: health, legal situation, religion.

questions.privacyPermanent: Choose with care: it cannot change later.
questions.label: Question
questions.removeOption: Remove this option. Answers that chose it keep it, marked as archived.
questions.catalanNeeded: Write it in Catalan at least.
questions.optionsNeeded: A choice question needs at least two options.
questions.failed: That did not work. Try again.

lock.required: This question is required, so it is always asked. Make it optional first to hide it.
lock.optionsList: The answers come from a fixed list the app uses (countries, municipalities or sizes), so only the question can be reworded.
lock.optionValues: You can reword or hide options. You cannot add or remove them, because the app reads what each one means.

answers.fileFailed: The file could not be opened.
answers.fileUnavailable: this server cannot open files yet
answers.hersOnly: only she can give it, on her phone
answers.doesNotFit: These answers do not fit their question: {{questions}}.

typeHelp.short_text: A short typed answer, like a name.
typeHelp.long_text: A longer text, to explain something.
typeHelp.single_choice: Pick one option from a few cards.
typeHelp.number: A number, whole or decimal, with a lowest and highest value if needed.
typeHelp.date: A date with day, month and year. You can ask for a lowest or highest age.
typeHelp.phone: A phone number with its country prefix, like +34 600 111 222.
typeHelp.search_choice: One option from a long list with a search box, like the country.
typeHelp.item_list: Items are added one by one, like the organizations that give support.
typeHelp.file_upload: A photo or a PDF. It is private: only staff who may read this level see it.
typeHelp.country: A country from the list of every country.
typeHelp.municipality: A municipality of Catalonia, from the official list.

questions.tooManyOptions: There are too many options for this type. For a long list, choose "One choice from a long list".
questions.settingsInvalid: Check the settings: the lowest cannot be above the highest, and ages are whole years.

settings.title: Settings of this type
settings.ageHint: The age is counted from the date she writes, on the day she answers.
settings.filePrivacy: The file is kept private. She sees it, and so do staff who may read the question’s privacy level.
settings.uploadsUnavailable: This server cannot store files yet. You can create the question, but her phone will say sending files is not available yet.
settings.pasteHint: One option per line, in Catalan. They are added to the ones above.

preview.title: How her phone shows it
preview.fallback: This question has no text in this language: she sees it in Catalan.

requiredLock.always: Her first name, last name and app language are always required: the team and the app need them to speak to her.

typeSamples.longText: I have lived in Girona with my two children for three years.

questions.healthReadersOnly: Only people with the health permission read it.
questions.labelRequiredIn: The question cannot be empty in {{language}}.

onboardingPage.title: Onboarding
onboardingPage.intro: The screens a player sees the first time she opens the app.

onboardingChain.count: {{total}} screens in total: {{onboarding}} in Onboarding · {{terms}} in the app terms · {{forms}} in forms
onboardingChain.nothingToAdd: There are no forms to add.
onboardingChain.countWithConditional: {{total}} screens in total: {{onboarding}} in Onboarding (+{{conditional}} conditional) · {{terms}} in the app terms · {{forms}} in forms

appTerms.sectionIntro: The text every player accepts before entering the app, with the introduction screen before it. A published version never changes; when you publish a new one, every player accepts it when she opens the app.
appTerms.editorIntro: Write each text in each language. Catalan is required; an empty language shows the Catalan text.

field.title: Terms title
field.media_hint: Note about the photo and video permission

appTerms.publishConfirm: Once published, the version cannot change and every player will have to accept it when she opens the app.
appTerms.publishNeedsAdmin: Only people who manage the organization settings can publish. Save the draft and tell them.
appTerms.invalid: Every text needs its Catalan version.
appTerms.published: Version published. Every player will accept it when she opens the app.

builtinScreens.detailNote: This screen opens depending on the previous answer.
builtinScreens.identityNote: The app is invitation only, and creating a player requires her name and surname. That is why this screen asks her to check them.
builtinScreens.hideLocked: It has a required question, so it always shows.
builtinScreens.hideReregistrationNote: Hiding it also stops re-registration asking its question each season, so the app and re-registration always ask the same.
builtinScreens.failed: Could not save. Please try again.

authorizationEditor.intro: Start from the draft or the current version. Edit language by language: each field shows the text she will see.
authorizationEditor.imageRightsLock: Image rights are always optional: they decide the photo consent, which she can withdraw.
authorizationEditor.textsIntro: The introduction, each step's title, the buttons, the final signing step and re-registration. Write {{season}} to show the season's name.

textField.flow_label: Process name on the progress bar
textField.sign_and_enter_label: Final button in her app (Sign and enter)
textField.sign_label: Final button on the tablet (Sign the authorization)
textField.signature_hint: Screen reader hint for the signing space

authorizationEditor.invalid: Some text is missing or a rule is broken: the title, sections and each consent need text in some language; the health question needs its consent; a required question must be asked; each document needs an https link.
authorizationEditor.publishNeedsAdmin: Only someone with the organization settings permission can publish the draft.

draftSeenByTestPlayers: Draft version (only test players see it)
